notes: The Bay Area Reporter, 7 January 1982 to 29 December 1983: the 104 weekly issues of those years in the Internet Archive collection bayareareporter (GLBT Historical Society scans, identifiers BAR_YYYYMMDD). Method as in the 1980-1981 batch: text and leaves rebuilt from each item's _djvu.xml, read by hand with no reader pass. The numbered-address passages were clustered by address and every cluster holding an event word was read, then the passages around fire, closing, moving and opening words with no number. Kept: a named business or institution opening, moving, closing or being displaced at an address on a stated date. Not kept: owners, managers, bartenders, performers, hosts and patrons; police raids and assaults; anniversaries; classified and personal advertisements; small shop openings told only by an advertisement; places outside San Francisco. A number the story does not print is taken from another issue of the paper and extra.placement_note says which. Not placed at all: grand openings at 4066 18th Street and 301 Turk Street whose names are lost in the scan; Operation Concern's departure from 2483 Clay Street; and an arson attempt at the SF Eagle in January 1982, told without a number.

coverage.remaining: 1984 to 2005 remain: 1,127 issues in the collection, January 1984 to 28 July 2005.
coverage.note: 104 issues; 9,246 numbered-address mentions on EAS streets, 759 windows after the advertisement filter in 640 address clusters, of which the 291 holding an event word were read, plus about 840 event-word passages filtered to those with a fire, closing, move or opening word. 32 findings written, each quote found again in the issue's text; 5 take their number from another issue or another street face of the same building. 28 resolved and published on 27 pages, two of them seeded: 1488 Pine Street, which takes up the Wild Goose opening held since the 1971-1975 batch, and 356 Seventh Street, the renovated fire station, which also settles the firehouse the 1981 paper printed as 365. 132 Bush is placed by hand on 130 Bush, the Heineman Building. 4 unresolved: 1 thin fact held on a parcel with no page (77 Battery) and 3 whose number EAS no longer has (342 and 348 Jones, 446 Castro, 54 Tenth). One date differs from a page: the paper has the Shanti Project at 890 Hayes from September 1982, where the page had it from 1983.
